y-m-81-05.title: Syllables na Hangul nawa ba su da baƙin harafi na ƙarshe?
y-m-81-05.goal: Bambance rabon siffofin da za a iya samarwa da rabon da ake amfani da shi a rubutu na gaske, sannan ka faɗi bayanai da hanyoyin da ake buƙata domin nemo na biyun.
y-m-81-05.material: Syllable ɗaya na Hangul na zamani yana ƙunshe da baƙin harafi na farko, wasali, da idan akwai baƙin harafi na ƙarshe (batchim). Yarjejeniya ga wannan aiki: a ƙirga zaɓuɓɓuka 19 na baƙin harafi na farko, 21 na wasali, da 28 na baƙin harafi na ƙarshe, tare da 'babu baƙin harafi na ƙarshe'. Zato: ana iya haɗa kowane baƙin farko, wasali, da na ƙarshe bisa so, sannan a ƙirga siffofin da za a iya samarwa. Ba za mu yi la'akari da ko ana amfani da syllables ɗin a zahiri ba.
y-m-81-05.thinking.0: Ƙiyasta rabo ta hanyar ƙa'idar ninkawa
y-m-81-05.thinking.1: Bambance yanayin da zai yiwu da yawan amfani da shi a zahiri
y-m-81-05.prereq.1: Ninka adadin yanayi, fractions da kashi-kashi
y-m-81-05.prereq.2: Iya karanta sunayen haruffan Hangul (bayani cewa ana gina syllable daga baƙin farko, wasali, da na ƙarshe yana cikin kayan aiki)
y-m-81-05.s.s1.prompt: Ƙiyasta: Cikin duk siffofin da za a iya ƙirƙira, kusan wane kaso ne syllables marasa baƙin harafi na ƙarshe?
y-m-81-05.s.s1.hint.0: Rubuta adadin duk syllables marasa baƙin ƙarshe da masu baƙin ƙarshe, kowannensu bisa adadin baƙaƙen farko, wasali, da na ƙarshe.
y-m-81-05.s.s1.hint.1: Idan ka nemo rabon ƙididdiga biyun, ka duba abin da ke faruwa ga adadin baƙaƙen farko da wasali.
y-m-81-05.s.s1.r.a: Ka kwatanta adadin yanayi marasa baƙin ƙarshe da duk yanayi. Ka yi amfani da cewa adadin baƙaƙen farko da wasali sun shiga ɓangarorin biyun daidai.
y-m-81-05.s.s1.r.b: Babu baƙin harafi na ƙarshe guda 1 cikin baƙaƙe 28 da za a iya zaɓa. Sake ƙirga kaso nawa ne guda ɗaya daga cikin 28 na jimillar.
y-m-81-05.s.s1.r.c: Ɗaukar rabon "babu baƙin harafi na ƙarshe" cikin zaɓuɓɓukan baƙaƙe 28 a matsayin kashi ɗaya bisa takwas ya yi yawa. Ana ninka baƙin farko da wasali iri ɗaya a kowane hali.
y-m-81-05.s.s1.r.d: Da alama ka raba shi gida biyu kawai, "yana da baƙin ƙarshe" da "ba shi da shi", sannan ka ɗauka rabin-rabi ne. Yanayin mai baƙin ƙarshe yana rabuwa zuwa zaɓuɓɓuka 27.
y-m-81-05.s.s1.explain: Syllables marasa baƙin ƙarshe suna da adadi 19×21=399, jimilla kuma 19×21×28=11172. Rabon 399÷11172=1/28≈3.6% ne. Ana ninka adadin baƙaƙen farko da wasali iri ɗaya ko akwai baƙin ƙarshe ko babu, saboda haka rabon ya zama guda 1 cikin baƙaƙe 28 na ƙarshe.
y-m-81-05.s.s2.prompt: Bayan ganin rabon da aka samo a sama, wani ɗalibi ya ce, "To a rubutu na gaske ma, haruffa marasa baƙin ƙarshe za su bayyana a wannan kaso kawai." Me kake tunani game da wannan magana?
y-m-81-05.s.s2.hint.0: Ka yi tunanin ko 'adadin siffofin da za a iya samarwa' da 'adadin lokutan da suke bayyana a rubutu' abu ɗaya ne.
y-m-81-05.s.s2.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin wane ƙarshe za ka samu idan kowane syllable ya bayyana sau iri ɗaya, da ko wannan zato gaskiya ne.
y-m-81-05.s.s2.o.a: A'a. Amma idan rubutun ya yi tsawo sosai, kai tsaye zai kusanci 3.6%.
y-m-81-05.s.s2.r.a: Ƙimar da ta tabbata yayin da rubutu ke ƙaruwa ita ce rabon da ake amfani da shi a rubutu. Ba ta zama rabon adadin siffofin da za a iya samarwa ba.
y-m-81-05.s.s2.o.b: Ba za a iya sani ba. Bayanai cewa akwai nau'o'in baƙin ƙarshe 28 na iya zama kuskure.
y-m-81-05.s.s2.r.b: 28 yarjejeniya ce ta wannan aiki. Matsalar ba adadin da aka amince da shi ba ce, illa ko za a iya mayar da rabon ƙididdiga zuwa yawan amfani.
y-m-81-05.s.s2.o.c: A'a. Muna buƙatar sanin sau nawa ake amfani da kowane harafi a rubutu.
y-m-81-05.s.s2.r.c: Ka bambance adadin siffofin da za a iya samu da ainihin yawan amfani. Ka gane cewa dole ne a binciki yawan amfani a matsayin bayani dabam.
y-m-81-05.s.s2.o.d: Eh. Rabon cikin duk haruffan da za a iya samu ne, saboda haka shi ne rabon rubutu ma.
y-m-81-05.s.s2.r.d: Rabon "siffofin da za a iya yi" da na "haruffan da ake amfani da su a zahiri" sun bambanta. Ya danganta da sau nawa ake amfani da kowane harafi.
y-m-81-05.s.s2.explain: 11172 shi ne adadin 'siffofin da za a iya amfani da su'. A rubutu na gaske, ana amfani da wasu syllables akai-akai, wasu kuma kusan ba a amfani da su. Idan ba a ɗauka cewa ana amfani da kowane siffa sau iri ɗaya ba, ba za a iya mayar da rabon ƙididdiga zuwa rabon amfani ba.
y-m-81-05.s.s3.prompt: Ta yaya za ka gano rabon syllables marasa baƙin ƙarshe a rubutu na gaske? Rubuta hanyar da aƙalla iyaka guda ta wannan hanya.
y-m-81-05.s.s3.hint.0: Zaɓi rubutu ɗaya da za ka karanta, sannan ka yi tunanin hanyar rarraba syllables gida biyu (ba shi da baƙin ƙarshe / yana da baƙin ƙarshe).
y-m-81-05.s.s3.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin ko za a iya amincewa da sakamakon idan ka zaɓi rubutu ɗaya kawai.
y-m-81-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka rubuta yadda za ka zaɓi rubutun da tsarin mayar da sakamakon da aka ƙirga zuwa rabo?
y-m-81-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Lokacin da ka rubuta iyakar, ka nuna a sarari 'abin da wannan hanya ba za ta iya gaya maka ba'?
y-m-81-05.s.s3.model.0: Zaɓi rubutu ɗaya, ƙirga syllables marasa baƙin ƙarshe, sannan ka raba da jimillar syllables domin samun rabo. Amma rubutu guda na iya karkata bisa sa'a, saboda haka ka tattara rubutu da dama ka ƙirga su ta hanya iri ɗaya domin amincewa da sakamakon.
y-m-81-05.s.s3.model.1: Zaɓi shafi guda na littafi, ƙirga syllables marasa baƙin ƙarshe da jimillar syllables, sannan nemo rabon. Shafi guda na iya bambanta bisa irin rubutu, saboda haka tattara ka kwatanta rubutu iri-iri da yawa kamar waƙoƙi da bayanin bayani.
y-m-81-05.s.s3.modelNote.1: Na bayyana a matsayin iyaka cewa sakamakon ya danganta da irin rubutu.
y-m-81-05.s.s3.model.2: Ƙirga haruffa marasa baƙin ƙarshe a rubutu guda sannan ka nemo rabon. Rubutu guda na iya nuna halayen rubutun kawai.

y-m-81-02.title: Mu tsara ƙa’idar shekarar tsalle da kanmu
y-m-81-02.goal: Fahimci cewa ƙa’idar shekarar tsalle tana saita matsakaicin tsawon shekara, ƙirƙiri ƙa’idoji da dama da suka cika sharuddan, sannan ka kwatanta ka bayyana girman kurakuransu.
y-m-81-02.material: Lokacin da Duniya ke ɗauka domin kewaya Rana sau ɗaya (shekarar yanayi) kusan kwanaki 365.2422 ne. Shekarar kalanda kwanaki 365 ko 366 ce (shekarar tsalle), saboda haka dole a yanke shawarar bayan shekaru nawa za a ƙara yini. Ana rubuta ƙa’ida a matsayin “saka ranakun tsalle L a zagayowar shekaru N”, kuma matsakaicin shekara shi ne 365+L÷N kwanaki. Zato: a ɗauki shekarar yanayi kwanaki 365.2422 ne, a kwatanta yadda kalanda ke karkacewa daga yanayi bisa bambancin matsakaitan.
y-m-81-02.thinking.0: Kiyasta girman karkacewar da ke taruwa
y-m-81-02.thinking.1: Tsara ƙa’idoji daban-daban a ƙarƙashin sharudda
y-m-81-02.prereq.0: “H3” a wannan aiki lakabin wahala da matakin tallafi na wannan rukuni ne kawai. Ba yana nufin an ware wani fanni ga wani aji ba. y-m-81-02.s.s1.prompt: Da farko yi kiyasi. Idan aka yi amfani da shekarar tsalle sau ɗaya duk shekaru 4 kawai (ƙara yini ɗaya duk shekara 4) aka ci gaba, kusan nawa kalanda za ta karkace daga yanayi bayan shekaru 1000?
y-m-81-02.s.s1.hint.0: Ga ƙa’idar shekaru 4, rubuta matsakaicin tsawon shekara kusa da kwanaki 365.2422, sannan ka kwatanta.
y-m-81-02.s.s1.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin abin da zai faru idan ƙaramin bambancin shekara ya taru sau 1000.
y-m-81-02.s.s1.r.a: Wataƙila ka ɗauki bambancin shekara a matsayin ƙarami fiye da kima, ko ka rasa matsayi ɗaya na darajar lambobi yayin ninkawa da adadin shekaru.
y-m-81-02.s.s1.r.b: Ka ɗauki bambancin shekara kusan sau 10 fiye da girmansa. Sake rubuta bambancin matsakaicin tsawon shekara ƙarƙashin ƙa’idar shekaru 4 da kwanaki 365.2422.
y-m-81-02.s.s1.r.c: Ka auna girman ta ninka ƙaramin bambancin da ke taruwa kowace shekara da adadin shekaru.
y-m-81-02.s.s1.o.d: Ba ya karkace (saboda akwai shekarun tsalle).
y-m-81-02.s.s1.r.d: Ko da akwai shekarun tsalle, idan matsakaicin bai yi daidai da shekarar yanayi ba, bambancin yana taruwa. Kwatanta matsakaitan.
y-m-81-02.s.s1.explain: Matsakaicin ƙa’idar shekaru 4 kwanaki 365.25 ne, shekarar yanayi kuma kusan kwanaki 365.2422, saboda haka bambancin kwanaki 0.0078 yana taruwa kowace shekara. Bayan shekaru 1000 zai zama kusan kwanaki 7.8, wato kusan kwanaki 8.
y-m-81-02.s.s2.prompt: Yanzu ƙirƙiri naka. Ga ƙa’idar “saka ranakun tsalle L a zagayowar shekaru N”, ƙirƙiri ƙa’idoji daban-daban guda 2 waɗanda matsakaicin shekara (365+L÷N kwanaki) yake tsakanin 0.0005 kwanaki na 365.2422. (N cikakkiyar lamba ce har zuwa 400, L kuma cikakkiyar lamba ce 0 ko sama.)
y-m-81-02.s.s2.hint.0: A matsakaicin 365+L÷N, L÷N dole ya kusanci 0.2422. Da farko zaɓi N, sannan ka sauya L ka kwatanta L÷N.
y-m-81-02.s.s2.hint.1: Gwada ko ƙaramin N ko babban N ne ke sauƙaƙa sanya kuskuren cikin iyakar da aka yarda.
y-m-81-02.s.s2.ok.c1: N da L cikakkun lambobi ne bisa sharuddan.
y-m-81-02.s.s2.fail.c1: N dole ya zama cikakkiyar lamba daga 1 zuwa 400, L kuma cikakkiyar lamba ce 0 ko fiye.

y-m-81-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Matsakaicin shekara ya bambanta da kwanaki 365.2422 fiye da 0.0005.
y-m-81-02.s.s2.explain: Misalai: kwanaki 8 cikin shekaru 33 (matsakaici kusan kwanaki 365.2424), kwanaki 31 cikin shekaru 128 (matsakaici 365.2421875), da kwanaki 97 cikin shekaru 400 (matsakaici 365.2425) duk sun cika sharadin. Ƙa’idoji masu rabo L÷N iri ɗaya (misali kwanaki 8 cikin shekaru 33 da 16 cikin shekaru 66) ana ƙirga su a matsayin ƙa’ida guda. Akwai wasu ƙa’idoji da yawa da suka dace.
y-m-81-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Ka bayyana da lambobi aƙalla sau ɗaya dalilin da ya sa ƙa’idar da ka zaɓa take karkacewa daga yanayi ƙasa da “shekarar tsalle duk shekaru 4”.
y-m-81-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Kwatanta matsakaicin ƙa’idarka da matsakaicin ƙa’idar shekaru 4 (365.25) kowannensu da 365.2422.
y-m-81-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Rubuta bambancin da ke taruwa kowace shekara ga ƙa’idojin biyu gefe da gefe.
y-m-81-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ka kwatanta karkacewar ƙa’idarka da ta ƙa’idar shekaru 4 bisa ma’auni iri ɗaya (matsakaicin shekara-shekara ko bayan wasu ɗaruruwan shekaru)?
y-m-81-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Maimakon rubuta “ya fi daidaito” kawai, ka nuna hujja da lambobi biyu ko fiye?
y-m-81-02.s.s2.because.model.0: Ƙa’idata tana da ranakun tsalle 97 cikin shekaru 400, saboda haka matsakaici 365.2425 ne, bambancinsa da 365.2422 kuma kwanaki 0.0003 ne. Ƙa’idar shekaru 4 tana da matsakaici 365.25, saboda haka tana karkace da kwanaki 0.0078 kowace shekara, wanda ke nufin ƙa’idata tana karkacewa ƙasa sosai.
y-m-81-02.s.s2.because.model.1: Da ranaku 8 cikin shekaru 33, matsakaicin shekara kusan 365.2424 ne, saboda haka kuskure kusan kwanaki 0.0002 ne. Wannan ya yi ƙasa sosai da kuskuren ƙa’idar shekaru 4, kwanaki 0.0078, saboda haka ko bayan shekaru 1000 karkacewarsa ba za ta kai yini ɗaya ba.
y-m-81-02.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: Na ƙara kiyasi na lamba cewa bayan shekaru 1000 karkacewar ba za ta kai yini ɗaya ba.
y-m-81-02.s.s3.prompt: Wannan rubutu ne da ke bayyana ƙa’idar shekarar tsalle da ƙasashe da yawa suke amfani da ita yanzu. Wane layi ne ke da kuskure?
y-m-81-02.s.s3.hint.0: Ga kowane layi, zaɓi shekarar misali guda ɗaya, sannan ka yi amfani da ƙa’idar baya kai tsaye a kanta.

y-m-81-02.s.s3.line.3: Saboda haka 1900, 2000, da 2100 duk ana iya raba su da 100, don haka shekarun gama-gari ne.

y-m-81-03.title: Jefa sandunan yut: shin kowane sakamako yana da yiwuwar iri ɗaya?
y-m-81-03.topic: Yiwuwa a wasan gargajiya na Yut
y-m-81-03.goal: Bambanta adadin sakamako da yiwuwar su yi daidai; yanke shawarar yadda kwatancen yiwuwar yut da mo ke canzawa idan sabon bayani da sharudda suka zo, sannan ka faɗi irin bayanin da ake buƙata.
y-m-81-03.material: A wasan yut, ana jefa sandunan yut 4 lokaci guda, sakamakon kuma yana dogara da yawan sandunan da suka sauka gefen lebur (ciki) a sama. Ciki 1 shi ne do, 2 gae, 3 geol, 4 yut, 0 (duk bayan zagaye) kuma mo. Zato: ana jefa sandunan ba tare da sun shafi juna ba (independent), kuma yiwuwar sanda ɗaya ta sauka gefen ciki sama ita ce p. Ga sandunan yut na gaske, p yana dogara da yadda aka ƙera su.
y-m-81-03.thinking.0: Nemo layin da kuskure ya fara
y-m-81-03.thinking.1: Daidaita hukuncinka da tabbaci bayan ganin sabon bayani
y-m-81-03.thinking.2: Nuna bayanin da ake buƙata domin yanke hukunci
y-m-81-03.prereq.1: Ƙirga yanayi (ƙa’idar ninkawa), ninkar yiwuwar abubuwa masu zaman kansu, kaso da rabo
y-m-81-03.prereq.2: Ko da ba ka taɓa buga yut ba, za ka iya warware wannan ta amfani da ƙa’idojin da aka bayyana a cikin kayan karatu kawai.
y-m-81-03.s.s1.prompt: Wani ɗalibi ya bayyana yiwuwar jefa sandunan yut kamar haka. A ɗauka yiwuwar sanda ɗaya ta sauka gefen ciki (gefen lebur) sama ita ce 1/2. A wane layi ne bayanin farko da ba daidai ba ya bayyana?
y-m-81-03.s.s1.hint.0: Sanya lambobi ①②③④ ga sandunan, sannan ka jera yawan cikin tsare-tsare 16 da suke da ciki guda 1 daidai.
y-m-81-03.s.s1.hint.1: Ƙirga a tebur yawan cikin tsare-tsare 16 da ke dacewa da do, gae, geol, yut, da mo kowanne, sannan ka kwatanta.
y-m-81-03.s.s1.line.0: Akwai nau’ikan sakamako guda biyar: do, gae, geol, yut, da mo.
y-m-81-03.s.s1.line.1: Tsare-tsaren sanduna 4 da suke nuna ciki ko baya su ne 2×2×2×2=16, kuma idan p=1/2, duk waɗannan tsare-tsare 16 suna da yiwuwar iri ɗaya.
y-m-81-03.s.s1.line.2: Amma sakamako biyar ne, saboda haka kowane sakamako yana da yiwuwar iri ɗaya.
y-m-81-03.s.s1.line.3: Saboda haka yiwuwar samun yut ita ce 1/5, yiwuwar samun mo ma 1/5 ce.
y-m-81-03.s.s1.explain: Kuskuren ya fara ne a layi na 3. Samun sakamako 5 ba ya sa dukkansu su zama masu yiwuwa iri ɗaya. Cikin tsarin 16, do (ciki 1) yana da 4, ga yana da 6, geol yana da 4, yut da mo kowannensu yana da 1, saboda haka yiwuwar su 4/16, 6/16, 4/16, 1/16, 1/16 ce. Layi na 4 ƙarshe ne da aka samo daga furucin da ba daidai ba a layi na 3.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.prompt: Ana bayyana bayanai ɗaya bayan ɗaya. Kowane lokaci zaɓi tunaninka game da tambayar nan: 'Wanne ne ya fi yawan fitowa, yut (ciki duk sanduna 4) ko mo (baya duk sanduna 4)?'
y-m-81-03.s.s2.hint.0: Ka yi tunanin yadda bayanin da aka bayar yanzu yake nuna ƙimar p da tabbaci.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.hint.1: Rubuta yiwuwar yut da ta mo ta hanyar raba su zuwa yiwuwar gefen ciki da na baya na kowace sanda.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.0.info: Dukkan sanduna 4 sandunan yut ne masu kyau da p=1/2. Cikin tsarin 16, yut yanayi 1 ne (dukkan ciki), mo ma yanayi 1 ne (dukkan baya).
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.0.ask: Wanne ne ya fi yawan fitowa, yut ko mo?
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.2.ask: Wanne ne ya fi yawan fitowa, yut ko mo?
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.0.after: Idan p=1/2, yut da mo dukkansu 1/16 ne, saboda haka sun yi daidai. Amma sandunan yut na gaske na iya samun p da ba daidai yake da 1/2 ba.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.0.o.a: Yut ya fi yawan fitowa. Ya fi zama abu na dabi'a a ce gefen ciki ya fuskanto sama.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.0.r.a: Ka ce p=1/2, saboda haka ciki da baya suna da yiwuwar iri ɗaya. Wannan dalili bai dace da zaton da aka bayar ba.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.0.o.b: Mo ya fi fitowa. Mo yana kai ka nesa, saboda haka wataƙila yana da wahala.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.0.r.b: Babban maki da ƙaramin yiwuwar samun su abubuwa ne daban-daban. Bisa wannan zato, ya kamata a kwatanta adadin yanayi.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.0.o.c: Sakamakon biyun yanayi 1 ne cikin 16, saboda haka suna fitowa daidai-daidai.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.0.r.c: Ka kwatanta ta hanyar ƙirga adadin yanayi. Wannan kwatanci yana dogara da zaton p=1/2.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.1.info: Ka jefa sanda ɗaya ta gaske sau 100, gefen ciki kuma ya fuskanto sama sau 60 (a ɗauka sanduna huɗu duka suna da siffa iri ɗaya).
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.1.ask: Me kake tunani game da yut da mo bayan ganin wannan bayani?
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.1.after: Yiwuwar samun 60 ko fiye cikin 100 idan p=1/2 kusan 3% ce. Ba kasafai ake samun haka ba, amma ba abu ne marar yiwuwa ba, saboda haka ko ka yi tunanin p ya fi 0.5 ko ka riƙe hukuncinka na farko, duka suna da ma'ana muddin ka bayyana shaidarka. Idan p=0.6, yut kusan 0.130 ne, mo kuma kusan 0.026, saboda haka yut yana da kusan yiwuwar sau 5.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.1.o.a: Ya zama 60, saboda haka za mu iya gyara p a 0.6, mu ce yut yana fitowa kusan sau 5 fiye da mo.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.1.r.a: Jefa sau 100 ba adadi mai yawa ba ne. 0.6 ƙiyasi ne, ba ƙima tabbatacciya ba, kuma yana iya zama 0.55 ko 0.65.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.1.o.b: p na iya zama kusan 0.6, saboda haka yut na iya fitowa fiye da mo. Amma a yi hankali da girman bambancin.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.1.r.b: Ka ambaci rashin tabbas a ƙiyasin ma. Hukuncinka ya danganta adadin bayanai da matakin tabbaci.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.1.o.c: Gefen ciki ya fuskanto sama sau 60, baya kuma sau 40, saboda haka rabon yut zuwa mo ma 60:40 ne, kusan sau 1.5.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.1.r.c: Domin samun yut, dole duk sanduna huɗun su nuna ciki, saboda haka ana ninka p sau huɗu. Ba za ka iya amfani da rabon sanda ɗaya yadda yake ba.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.1.o.d: Samun 60 cikin 100 na iya faruwa bisa sa'a, saboda haka har yanzu akwai ƙaramin dalilin barin hukuncin farko cewa p=1/2.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.1.r.d: Ka yi la'akari da zangon da sa'a za ta iya bayyanawa sannan ka riƙe hukuncin farko. Za ka iya kuma tunanin nisan da zai sa ya yi wuya a kira shi sa'a.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.2.info: Sanduna huɗun sun bambanta: sanduna biyu suna da yiwuwar gefen ciki 0.6, sauran biyun kuma 0.4 (sandunan ba sa shafar juna).
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.2.after: Yut ita ce 0.6×0.6×0.4×0.4=0.0576, mo kuma 0.4×0.4×0.6×0.6=0.0576, saboda haka sun yi daidai. Idan p na duk sanduna iri ɗaya ne, yut da mo suna daidaita ne kawai idan p=1/2; amma idan kowace sanda ta bambanta, za su iya daidaita haka ba da gangan ba.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.2.o.a: Yut ya fi yawan fitowa, domin wasu sanduna suna da yiwuwar gefen ciki 0.6.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.2.r.a: Akwai sandunan 0.6, amma akwai na 0.4 ma. Rubuta yiwuwar yut da ta mo kowaccensu a matsayin ninkawa sannan ka kwatanta.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.2.o.b: Ba za a iya yanke hukunci daga sharadin cewa sanduna ba sa shafar juna kaɗai ba.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.2.r.b: Da sharadin 'ba sa shafar juna', za ka iya ninka yiwuwar. Sake duba ko an riga an bayar da ƙimomin da kake buƙata.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.2.o.c: Mo ya fi fitowa, domin wasu sanduna suna da ƙaramin yiwuwar gefen ciki.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.2.r.c: Ga mo ma dole ne a yi la'akari da cewa sanda mai yiwuwar 0.6 tana sauka a bayanta da yiwuwar 0.4.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.2.o.d: Sun yi daidai. Yut ita ce 0.6×0.6×0.4×0.4, mo kuma 0.4×0.4×0.6×0.6, saboda haka ninkawarsu iri ɗaya ce.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.2.r.d: Ka kwatanta yut da mo ta rubuta kowannensu a matsayin ninkawa. Ka lura an yi amfani da lambobi iri ɗaya a biyun, sandunan suna nuna ciki a gefe ɗaya da baya a ɗayan.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.reflect: Yaya hukuncinka lokacin da p=1/2 ya canza bayan bayanin jifa 100 da kuma bayan sanin cewa p ya bambanta daga sanda zuwa sanda? Faɗi ko sabon bayani ya canza hukuncinka ko matakin tabbacin ka.
y-m-81-03.s.s3.prompt: Domin a ce 'yut da mo suna da yiwuwar iri ɗaya', wane ƙarin bayani ake buƙata, kuma ta yaya za ka iya kwatanta su bayan ka same shi? Rubuta shi.
y-m-81-03.s.s3.hint.0: Rubuta gefe da gefe yadda kowace sanda dole ta faɗi domin yut da yadda kowace dole ta faɗi domin mo.
y-m-81-03.s.s3.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin ƙimomin da kake buƙatar sani domin kwatanta biyun da lambobi.
y-m-81-03.s.s3.placeholder: Misali: Da farko ina buƙatar sanin ...
y-m-81-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Bayanin da ka rubuta da gaske ana amfani da shi wajen lissafa yiwuwar yut da ta mo?
y-m-81-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka kuma yi tunanin ko sandunan suna shafar juna (rashin dogaro)?
y-m-81-03.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka bambance 'idan p ɗin duka iri ɗaya ne' da 'idan kowace sanda ta bambanta'?
y-m-81-03.s.s3.model.0: Kana buƙatar sanin yiwuwar p ta kowace sanda na sauka gefen ciki. Idan p na sanduna huɗu iri ɗaya ne, yut da mo suna daidaita ne kawai idan p=1/2; idan sanduna sun bambanta, dole ne ka kwatanta ninkawar yiwuwar gefen cikinsu da ninkawar yiwuwar bayanansu.
y-m-81-03.s.s3.model.1: Kana buƙatar sanin yiwuwar saukar gefen ciki ta kowace sanda da ko sandunan suna shafar juna (rashin dogaro). Da waɗannan ƙimomi, ninka duk yiwuwar gefen ciki domin yut da duk yiwuwar baya domin mo, sannan ka kwatanta.

y-m-81-06.prereq.0: “H3” a wannan aiki lakabin wahala da matakin tallafi na wannan rukuni ne kawai. Ba yana nufin an ware wani fanni ga wani aji ba. An ɗauka batu “Lissafi da Al’adu” ɗalibai ne suka ɗauka bayan sun riga sun koyi lissafin sakandare babba (lambobi, lissafi, ayyuka, da yiwuwa mai sauƙi).
y-m-81-06.title: Idan kusurwa ɗaya ta dace, dukan tsarin ma zai yi?
y-m-81-06.topic: Tsarin Polygon Mai Daidaito da Shimfiɗa Fage
y-m-81-06.goal: Nemo haɗuwa da dama da kusurwoyinsu a ƙoli ɗaya suka tara zuwa 360°, sannan ka yanke hukuncin cewa wannan sharadi bai wadatar ba domin cika fage gaba ɗaya.
y-m-81-06.material: Idan ana yin tsari, ana haɗa fale-falen polygon masu daidaito ba tare da gurabe ko haɗuwa ba. Kusurwoyin fale-falen da suka haɗu a ƙoli ɗaya dole su tara zuwa 360°. Girman kusurwa guda na polygon mai gefe n yana ƙayyadewa bisa n (triangle mai daidaito 60°, murabba'i mai daidaito 90°, hexagon mai daidaito 120°). A wannan aiki za mu duba yanayin polygon mai daidaito uku suna haɗuwa a ƙoli guda, kuma adadin gefuna natural number ne daga 3 zuwa 50.
y-m-81-06.thinking.1: Nemo haɗuwa daban-daban da suka cika sharuɗɗan
y-m-81-06.thinking.2: Bambance sharuɗɗan da ake buƙata da waɗanda suka wadatar
y-m-81-06.prereq.1: Girman kusurwar ciki ta polygon mai daidaito (geomitirin makarantar sakandare ta ƙasa), warware fractions da equations
y-m-81-06.prereq.2: Fahimtar yadda polygons masu daidaito ke kewaye da aya ɗaya (kusurwoyi suna tara cikakken juyi)
y-m-81-06.s.s1.prompt: Yi hasashe tukuna. Bayan triangles masu daidaito uku (6,6,6), waɗanne haɗuwa ne na polygons masu daidaito uku a ƙoli guda suke da kusurwoyi da suka tara zuwa 360°? (n-gon yana da gefuna n, n kuma bai wuce 50 ba.)
y-m-81-06.s.s1.hint.0: Idan akwai triangle mai daidaito guda ɗaya (60°), ka yi tunanin abin da jimillar kusurwoyin polygons biyun ya kamata ta zama.
y-m-81-06.s.s1.hint.1: Yi amfani da hanya iri ɗaya idan akwai murabba'i mai daidaito guda (90°), sannan nemo wasu haɗuwa kaɗan.
y-m-81-06.s.s1.r.a: Polygons masu daidaito ban da triangle, murabba'i, da hexagon (kamar octagon mai daidaito) ma suna da kusurwoyi. Me zai faru idan ka gwada ɗaya ko biyu?
y-m-81-06.s.s1.o.b: Akwai haɗuwa kaɗan kawai da suka ƙunshi triangle mai daidaito.
y-m-81-06.s.s1.r.b: Duba ko akwai haɗuwa ba tare da triangle mai daidaito ba. Yaya jimillar da ta ƙunshi pentagon mai daidaito ko octagon mai daidaito?
y-m-81-06.s.s1.r.c: Ka bar yiwuwar amfani da polygons ban da triangle, murabba'i, da hexagon masu daidaito. Za ka iya bincika kai tsaye domin gano adadin.
y-m-81-06.s.s1.r.d: Yana da wuya a sami dalilin cewa ƙarin guda ɗaya ne kawai. Ƙirga kai tsaye adadin haɗuwar da za ka iya yi da polygons ban da triangle, murabba'i, da hexagon masu daidaito.
y-m-81-06.s.s1.explain: Idan ka nemi su da kanka a mataki na gaba, za ka ga akwai haɗuwa 10 gaba ɗaya, tare da (6,6,6).
y-m-81-06.s.s2.prompt: Nemo sannan shigar da haɗuwa daban-daban 4 inda polygon mai daidaito a-gefe, b-gefe, da c-gefe suka haɗu a ƙoli guda kuma kusurwoyinsu suka tara daidai 360°. (3 ≤ a ≤ b ≤ c ≤ 50, duk natural numbers ne. Ana ɗaukar haɗuwa mai jeri dabam a matsayin misali guda.)
y-m-81-06.s.s2.hint.0: Yi jadawalin girman kusurwa ɗaya na polygon mai daidaito n-gefe sannan ka rubuta wasu farawa daga 3.
y-m-81-06.s.s2.hint.1: Da farko zaɓi ƙaramin a, nemo abin da jimillar kusurwoyin biyun sauran ya kamata ta zama, sannan canza b.
y-m-81-06.s.s2.var.a: Polygon mai daidaito na farko (adadin gefuna)
y-m-81-06.s.s2.var.b: Polygon mai daidaito na biyu (adadin gefuna)
y-m-81-06.s.s2.var.c: Polygon mai daidaito na uku (adadin gefuna)
y-m-81-06.s.s2.ok.c1: Adadin gefuna natural numbers ne daga 3 zuwa 50.
y-m-81-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Dole adadin gefuna ya zama natural numbers daga 3 zuwa 50.
y-m-81-06.s.s2.ok.c2: Ka shigar da su bisa jeri a ≤ b ≤ c.
y-m-81-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Da fatan ka shigar da su bisa jeri a ≤ b ≤ c.
y-m-81-06.s.s2.fail.c3: Jimillar kusurwoyin ukun ba ta kai 360° ba.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.prompt: Duba (5,5,10) cikin haɗuwoyin da ka samo. A ƙoli guda, pentagons masu daidaito biyu da decagon mai daidaito guda za su iya cika 360°. To wannan haɗuwa ita kaɗai za ta iya samar da tsari da ke cika fage gaba ɗaya ba tare da gurabe ba?
y-m-81-06.s.s3.hint.0: Zana ƙolayen siffofin maƙwabta kewaye da gefe ɗaya na decagon mai daidaito, sannan ka duba ko haɗuwa iri ɗaya za ta ci gaba.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.hint.1: Idan pentagons masu daidaito biyu suka haɗu a gefe ɗaya, duba ko ƙoli maƙwabcin zai ba da haɗuwa iri ɗaya.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.o.a: Daidaituwa a aya guda bai isa a sani ba. Dole ne a bincika dabam ko ƙolayen maƙwabta ma sun dace.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.r.a: Ka bambance dacewa a aya guda da dacewa a ko'ina. Ka tsara abin da sharadin buƙata yake da abin da sharadin wadatarwa yake.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.o.b: (4,6,12) kaɗai, haɗuwar da ke amfani da nau'o'i ukun duka, ce za ta iya cika fage gaba ɗaya ba tare da gurabe ba.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.r.b: (6,6,6) da (4,8,8) ma suna da tsare-tsaren da ke cika fage gaba ɗaya. Adadin nau'o'i ba ma'auni ba ne.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.o.c: Kusurwoyin ƙoli ɗaya sun tara daidai, saboda haka ci gaba da wannan hanya kullum zai cika fage gaba ɗaya.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.r.c: Tara kusurwoyi daidai a aya guda sharadin buƙata ne. Ko ƙolayen maƙwabta ma za su yi aiki da haɗuwa iri ɗaya wani abu ne dabam.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.o.d: Adadin haɗuwar da suke aiki a ƙoli guda kullum yana daidai da adadin tsare-tsaren da ke cika fage.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.r.d: Tambayar ita ce ko kowace haɗuwa za ta cika fage gaba ɗaya. Babu dalilin da ya sa adadin haɗuwa da adadin tsare-tsare za su yi daidai.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.explain: Tara kusurwoyi a ƙoli guda zuwa 360° sharadin buƙata ne, ba sharadin wadatarwa ba. Kamar yadda aka sani, cikin 10 ɗin sama, (3,12,12), (4,6,12), (4,8,8), da (6,6,6) kaɗai ne suke cika fage gaba ɗaya da tsarin ƙoli guda iri ɗaya; (5,5,10) ba zai iya cika fage ba domin ci gaba zuwa ƙolayen maƙwabta yana haifar da saɓani.
